card.summary: H.R. 9706, titled the 'Facial Recognition to Protect Children Act', requires operators of wagering and prediction market platforms to use commercially available facial recognition technology to verify that users are over 18 years of age. It limits data collection to what is necessary for age verification and mandates the deletion of unnecessary data. The Federal Trade Commission is tasked with enforcement. The bill also amends the Commodity Exchange Act to grant the Commodity Futures Trading Commission additional oversight and authority regarding event contracts, including prohibiting certain event contracts contrary to the public interest, regulating promotional communications and anti-money laundering programs, establishing an Advisory Council on Consumer Protection, and creating an Office of the Retail Advocate.
